items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: before Diz was in there John Kirby had a band in there... That was a good band, very good band, and a lot of people used to go in there to hear them.

ctx.x: Well, when I was in the Yacht Club, he was in the Downbeat. When I was in the Down -- he did go from club to club and the Downbeat later, but Dizzie never at and them were at the Onyx Club, and before Diz was in there John Kirby had a band in there. That was Billy Kyle on piano, Charlie Shavers on trumpet, Buster Bailey on clarinet, O'Neill Spencer on drums. He died years ago.

You know, everybody in that band is dead except Procope -- Russell Procope. He was on that band. That was a good band, very good band, and a lot of people used to go in there to hear them. They had a fantastic little group. Billy Kyle told me in fact that they rehearsed six months before they ever played a job. They rehearsed just -- they played different jobs, and they would get together and rehearse; you know, to make a living they all of them had different places they played, but he said they rehearsed about…
